name: GEOMETRY_CONDITIONED_EXPANDED_LATERAL_FACTOR_SPACE_V2
scope: seen-only offline method design; online-generatable inputs only
path_family: existing five-knot four-segment C2 quintic-Hermite Frenet P3

strict_side_domain.connected_components: intersection of station-wise feasible corridor intervals over the blocking cluster, clipped to strict target bounds, at most two

target_sources.corridor_centers: bottleneck center, blocking-span midpoint center, and exact center at every sampled reference/corridor station in the blocking span
target_sources.formula: d_target = clamp(near + f*(far-near), strict_lower, strict_upper) or an explicitly listed geometry anchor

lateral_factor_generator.exact_tuple_deduplication: exact binary64 hex keys for side,d_target,d_mid

transition_factor_generator.rule: all unique exact (entry_scale,exit_scale) pairs already generated by production for that evaluator input

station_semantics.outside_side: sum reference curvature from the nearest reference index at blocking-cluster midpoint through 2.0 m; outside_is_left iff sum < 0
station_semantics.z0_to_z4: exact stationsFor semantics reconstructed before P3 construction

preconstruction_shape_deduplication.purpose: remove tuples known before reconstruction to define the same P3 offset profile

seen_observed_cheap_pool_counts_all_86.interpretation: cheap arithmetic only; the full pair pool is not reconstructed or exact-validated
